snippet.title: ShapeNeon Chaos - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
ShapeNeon Chaos is an old school style space-shooter. You are a ship facing off waves of deadly enemies. This game was made to give you a shot of adrenaline in a couple of minutes. Lots of bullets and neon in an arcade psychedelic shooter!

Developed by Beni Games
Published for console by Antonio Filipe / AFIL Games
Also released on PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5

#ps4 #playstation4 #theforeseenarcade #shapeneonchaos
